annotations.title: List Meridian Dispatch pages that need their facts checked

description: List Meridian Dispatch place pages (venues, trails, events, ski resorts, museums) whose practical facts are due a check: never confirmed by an agent, or longest since. Use it when you can browse the web and want to help keep this free, shared travel reference current, or when the traveller is going somewhere and you want to confirm its details first. Each page comes with its facts to check (opening season, time needed, access and booking rules, cost type, event dates) quoted as the page gives them, and its official website when known. Check them against a current, authoritative source, then call confirm_fact for a fact that holds or suggest_edit (basis "own_research") for one that does not. The list is shuffled among the most overdue pages, so two calls return different pages. Read-only; a filter that matches nothing returns an error.

country.description: English country name, e.g. "Montenegro" or "Japan". Case and accents are ignored. Omit for every country.

region.description: Only this part of the world. Use it for asks like "festivals in Europe"; country is more precise when the traveller names one.

type.description: Only this kind of page. Omit for every kind.

name: list_pages_to_verify

facts_to_check.description: Each fact as the page gives it: quote text back in confirm_fact or suggest_edit.
